Hi Priyom / Ben,

We're approaching our renewal window and we've got two asks that we need to fold into the contract amendment: 1) add three additional isolated VPC clusters to support our new analytics ingestion pipeline (expected steady-state ~75 qps, peak ~240 qps), and 2) reserve a small burst pool (20% buffer) during business hours for month-end spikes.

We'd also like to move from the current 24-month staggered term to a consolidated 12-month commitment across all environments to simplify procurement. That will change billing cadence and I'd expect some proration on the remaining term. Can you share a PO-able amendment and estimate for one-year pricing (including the three clusters and burst reserve)?

Laura — thanks for the signal and the usage file. Quick notes / proposal below.

Summary proposal (ballpark):
- Add 3 isolated VPC clusters (us-west-2 primary) with dedicated tenancy and network isolation.
- Add a dedicated burst reserve equivalent to ~20% of committed capacity during 9am–6pm PT. This is implemented as a warm standby headroom pool that can be billed as reserved burst units.
- Consolidate to a single 12-month commitment across all environments. We'll credit remaining prorated value on current staggered contract toward the new 12-month commitment.

Attached: Proposed-Term-Table-v3.xlsx (pricing matrix and proration examples). The attached includes two pricing scenarios: standard list and an anchored 12-month commit (we can go to an extra credit for earlier signature).

Operational notes:
- We will need a security attestation (SOC 2 scoping doc) for the new isolated clusters; Marissa, can you confirm the artifacts and expected lead time?
- Typical provisioning window is 3–5 weeks from PO for fully isolated clusters; burst-pool capacity can be added in 1–2 business days once the reserved capacity is allocated.

Next steps: if procurement can target Oct 11 for PO, we'll prepare the DocuSign amendment and an SOW by EOD Oct 7. Ben — can you confirm the capacity sizing and any recommended warm-up steps?

Thanks,
Priyom Das

Laura / team — technical follow-up with capacity detail and rollout recommendation.

Capacity & sizing (3 additional clusters):
- Each cluster: 8x A10G-ish GPU nodes (Nvidia A100 class), expected steady throughput ~25 qps per cluster for the analytics model given typical prompt sizes; peak headroom per cluster ~80 qps.
- Combined steady-state: ~75 qps; combined peak: ~240 qps.
- Burst pool: we recommend reserving the equivalent of 1.5 clusters (to achieve ~20% buffer) and gating it with a prefix cache warmup during month-end windows.

Deployment plan:
1) Provision two staging clusters for smoke/canary in us-west-2 (2 weeks).
2) Provision third cluster and promote to production with traffic weighting over 72 hours.
3) Apply circulation window and KV cache pre-warm at month-end; expected warm-up run takes 6–8 hours.

Pricing note: if HelioMed signs a consolidated 12-month commitment and confirms PO by Oct 11, we can offer a 10% uplift credit on the cluster unit price (applied across all three new clusters).

Attachment: capacity-snapshot.png (architectural sketch)
